ModMetaData.name: RimMandrake: Watchers
ModMetaData.author: mandrake
ModMetaData.description:
WATCHER_CREATURES_MOD_1: shy creatures that sit, peek out, watch you, and jerk back under cover when anything that is not their own kind comes near. A standalone kit (owner ruling 2026-09-30); a biome's roster draws on it. Design: design/RimMandrake/watcher_creatures_kit_design_2026-10-02.md.
Ships: 1. The kit. RM_WatcherExtension on a race opts it in; the comp is injected at startup, so a member writes XML only. Hidden -> peeks out -> watches (turns to face the nearest pawn) -> flinches and hides when a non-own-kind pawn comes within its flinch radius, a neighbour's alarm reaches it, one of its own cues holds, or (optional geophone) something large swims under the sand nearby -> re-emerges after a delay. A hidden watcher always leaves a sign on its cell: no animal vanishes without a readable sign. 2. Medium lock: a watcher wanders only on its medium terrain and walks back to it when found off it; it only ever hides on its medium. 3. Death (owner ruling 2026-10-08): watchers cannot be flushed. Nothing can aim at a hidden one, and a visible one is an ordinary target. Almost no damage kills one, and fire, explosions and acid reach it even while it hides. It leaves small, sad remains of dubious value. 4. Alarm ripple: when one ducks from something close, or dies, a few neighbours duck too, in a short wave that cannot loop. 5. First member: the piinnok of the Stillsand, the watching glass, locked to deep sand. 6. Mod Settings: master, hide and flinch, turn to face, stay on medium, geophone, alarm ripple, one toggle per cue, flinch radius, re-emerge delay, max active watchers per map.
Works alone. With RimMandrake: FlowWorks the piinnok's medium (deep sand) exists; with RimMandrake: Baroque Biomes it filter-feeds the sand and its lenses sink for submerged sand swimmers.
